hardware.requirements: Switchless 0-1-2-3-0 cable cycle with the managed-mesh fabric plan applied: routes, neighbor tables and the hardware-offloaded tc-flower relay rule (EtherType 0x88b5) on every rail, as installed by the GLM-5.3 managed-mesh fabric service. The launcher refuses to start with SIRCL enabled when no relay rule is present.

model.quantization: fp8 attention and dense projections, MXFP4 routed experts (checkpoint fp8 quantization config with mxfp4 store dtype), bf16 DFlash draft
model.identity_note: MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL (MIT): 48 layers, 9 global-attention layers with 4 KV heads and 39 sliding-window layers with 8 KV heads and a 128-token window; Q/K head 192, V head 128; bundled five-layer DFlash draft (block size 8); vision and audio encoders. The pinned revision's dflash/config.json is valid JSON; earlier revisions need the launcher's corrected copy.

runtime.entrypoint: /opt/venv/bin/python -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main serve, exec'd from a login shell (entrypoint attestation bypassed for the overlay)

serving.kv_cache_dtype: fp8 for the draft; the target keeps a bf16 KV cache (no checkpoint K/V scales; an fp8 target cache repeats itself on long outputs)
serving.attention_backend: TRITON_ATTN_DIFFKV with the PR 839 split-KV verification dispatch
serving.linear_backend: auto (the 3392-wide global-attention QKV slice at TP4 is not a multiple of 128, so linear kernels are chosen per layer)

cudagraph.note: A C8 decode step with a 5-token draft is 48 query rows; a 64-token ceiling keeps it on the captured width-4096 SIRCL graph lane.

collectives.all_reduce: SIRCL custom mode: graph-only session on the primary rail pair for captured width-4096 collectives and the fused bidirectional prefill session on both rail pairs for eager [Q <= 8192, 4096] tensors; RoCEnante virtual diagonals over the hardware relay; PyNCCL over the four rails for everything else (custom all-reduce disabled)
collectives.sircl_environment: The SPARK_TP4_* and VLLM_SPARK_* assignments of the GLM-5.3 managed-mesh profile's rendered rank environment, plus VLLM_SPARK_TP4_MODE=custom and VLLM_SPARK_TP4_VOCAB_MODE=custom

serving.sizing_note: The 16-sequence admission limit and the 20 GiB KV reservation are configuration choices; 20 GiB is the largest reservation that leaves room for both SIRCL sessions during warmup. They are not throughput or per-request guarantees.

evidence.conditions: Single site, 2026-09-22; single-stream 600-token decode, eight concurrent 300-token decodes at about 8K context, cold 48K and 120K prefill with 300-token decode, 1500-token repetition test at greedy and T=1.0; one image request. Relay-rule hardware counters observed increasing under load.
evidence.result: Single stream 63.4 tok/s; C8 aggregate 184.0 tok/s; 48K cold prefill 3,721 tok/s with 55.7 tok/s decode; 120K cold prefill 2,901 tok/s with 46.6 tok/s decode; repetition tests clean; image check passes; 2,189,381 KV tokens. The same launch on PyNCCL with a 30 GiB reservation measured 57.8 / 151.1 / 3,826 and 53.5 / 2,933 and 48.8 with 3,284,072 KV tokens.
evidence.conclusion: Serves with both SIRCL sessions up on every rank over the hardware-forwarded mesh. Not qualified: no soak, no accuracy suite, no independent reproduction.
limitations: Overlay files replace image sources at launch; the image's attestation entrypoint is bypassed.
Throughput values are single runs from one benchmark script on one day; the noise band is about 3 percent single-stream and 5 percent at C8.
Every follower prints an AssertionError (collective_rpc on a follower node) during KV sizing and continues; it is not an error condition in this build.
Video and audio inputs are enabled but only an image request was checked on this topology.

provenance.transport_implementation: SIRCL with RoCEnante virtual diagonals over the managed mesh; patched NVIDIA NCCL fallback
